title: Indigo Plateau: Elite Four & Champion
subtitle: Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance, then your rival

steps.text: Recommended: six Pokémon around Lv.55, a dozen Full Restores/Hyper Potions, several Revives. No healing between battles except your items. The rival's team depends on your starter — check Battle for the exact one.

Lorelei (Ice/Water): Dewgong Lv.52, Cloyster Lv.51, Slowbro Lv.52, Jynx Lv.54, Lapras Lv.54. Electric moves hit four of five; Fighting for Jynx and Cloyster; Grass for Slowbro. Watch Sheer Cold and Lapras's Hydro Pump.
Bruno (Fighting/Rock): Onix Lv.51 ×2, Hitmonchan Lv.53, Hitmonlee Lv.53, Machamp Lv.56. Psychic and Flying for the fighters; Water/Grass for Onix. Alakazam or Lapras carry this.

Agatha (Ghost/Poison): Gengar Lv.54 and Lv.58, Golbat Lv.54, Haunter Lv.53, Arbok Lv.56. Psychic hits everything except nothing is immune; Earthquake also works on Gengar/Haunter/Arbok. She spams Confuse Ray and Toxic: keep Full Heals.
Lance (Dragon): Gyarados Lv.56, Dragonair Lv.54 ×2, Aerodactyl Lv.58, Dragonite Lv.60. Ice Beam is the answer for the dragons (4× on Dragonite), Electric for Gyarados, Rock/Ice/Water for Aerodactyl.

Champion: your rival. Pidgeot Lv.59, Alakazam Lv.57, Rhydon Lv.59, plus two of Gyarados/Arcanine/Exeggutor and his starter at Lv.63. He uses Full Restores. Lead with something fast against Pidgeot, keep a Water type for Rhydon and Arcanine, and a Bug/Ghost/physical hitter for Alakazam.

Hall of Fame. The credits roll and you restart at home. Post-game: talk to Oak, then Celio on One Island needs the Ruby and Sapphire (chapters 17-18). 60 Kanto Pokémon caught unlocks the National Dex.
